retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome composition featuring a central figure in a vampire cape within a gothic interior, topped with dripping horror-style lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure dressed as a vampire stands on a dark staircase, holding his cape wide to create a broad horizontal shape. The scene is set in a gothic hall with a banister on the left and a stained-glass window on the right. The lighting is dramatic and high-contrast, with the title rendered in a stylized, dripping 'horror' font centered at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The wide horizontal span of the cape anchors the central third of the frame.
The verticality of the staircase and window frames the central figure.
The white dripping text contrasts sharply against the dark upper background.
The figure's face is the primary focal point, highlighted by directional lighting.
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white tonal range
Dripping liquid effect on all letterforms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, occupying the middle vertical axis and the entire horizontal width via the outstretched cape.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the white title text directly above it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright title, move down to the face, and then follow the cape's edges to the architectural details of the stairs and window.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blacks in the upper corners and lower staircase create a heavy, atmospheric frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for text and highlights on the cape
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the architectural textures
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical 'drips' of varying lengths descending from the baseline and crossbars
Heavy, rounded terminals resembling liquid droplets
Slightly arched baseline for the main word
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has exaggerated curves with drips from the top and bottom hooks
The 'i' dot is integrated into a drip from the top

composition.relationshipToImage: floating in negative space above the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative style used for all text to maintain thematic consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classic dripping horror aesthetic.
Matches the gothic, jagged serif undertones.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a man in a tuxedo and vampire cape standing on a gothic staircase with a stained glass window in the background, leaving the top third of the frame as solid black negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom white lettering with a dripping liquid effect, centered in the upper black area, following a slight upward arch.

verificationChecks: Is the text strictly white on a black background?
Does the lettering feature vertical drips?
Is the cape held wide to create a horizontal anchor?

adjustableVariables: Degree of the arch in the text

mustAchieve: Legible but highly stylized dripping text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the drips do not obscure the letter legibility.
Verify the monochrome palette is strictly maintained.
Check that the subject is centered and the cape is symmetrical.
Confirm the text is positioned in the upper negative space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [subject in gothic costume] with [high-contrast monochrome photography] and [dripping horror-style display typography] centered in the [upper negative space].
